## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.15

- Fixes an immediate startup crash on tablets in landscape orientation when Activity history is present.
- Uses the current Activity, log, and SMB setup layouts on tablet and landscape screens. Older alternate layouts lacked views required by the updated app and could crash when those screens opened.

The APK uses the established package and signing certificate. Install it over the existing SMBsync+ app to keep saved tasks and credentials.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
